x: I challenge you!
Hey, you! I challenge you to a contest! See you {event_in}!
Hey, team! I challenge you to a contest: who is best? See you {event_in}, and may the strongest win!
We accept!
We accept the challenge! We will train!
We accept the challenge! We start training today, together and with fun, {fr}!
Training? Hooray!
Training? I am in! But with a break for juice.
Training? I am in! Especially for the break where everyone eats biscuits.
The door is locked!
The door is locked, and time is running. We need magic words!
The door to training is locked, and time is flying. We need magic words!

q: What does the friend want at training?
What does the friend like best?

x: How shall we train?
How shall we train? You choose!
How shall we train? You choose, {name}, we have time!
Faster! Even faster!
We train speed: the wind is whistling!
We train speed: the wind whistles in our ears, and {fr} already wants a break!
I have a move!
I have a clever move! Look!
I have a clever move! It is so clever that even I do not understand it yet!

end: Oh no! It is gone!
Trouble! {tool} vanishes right before training!
But in the morning, trouble! {tool} vanishes right out of our hands, and only a few hours are left until the contest.

rec: We ran fast!
Yesterday we trained speed, and today, trouble!
Yesterday we trained speed, and the wind whistled in our ears. And today there is trouble!
The clever move is ready!
Yesterday we thought up a clever move, and today, trouble!
Yesterday we thought up a clever move, and it almost worked. And today there is trouble!

x: Where is {tool}?
{fr}, I looked everywhere for {tool_acc}. Nothing!
{fr}, I am looking everywhere for {tool_acc}: on the shelf, under the table, in the bag, and it is not there!
It is {rival}!
It must be {rival}! Nobody else would!
It must be {rival}! Who else giggles so slyly round the corner?
Not so fast, {fr}.
We must not blame anyone without proof. Let's look!
We must not blame anyone without proof, {fr}. Fair play means we check first.
The drawer will not open!
{tool} is in a locked drawer. We need magic words!
Found it! {tool} is in a locked drawer. We need magic words!

q: What must we not do without proof?

x: What do we do next?
What do we do next? Follow the tracks or ask?
What do we do next? Follow the tracks or ask everyone honestly?
Tracks! Let's go!
The tracks lead round the corner. Let's go, nice and quiet!
The tracks lead round the corner! I tiptoe along. Maybe it is a secret mission?
Will you help us?
{rival}, will you help us find it? Honestly!
{rival}, we are not blaming you, we are asking: will you help us find it? It is more fun together!

end: A signal! Run!
Suddenly a signal booms: the contest starts now!
But then a signal booms: the contest starts right now, and we are still far from the start!

rec: We followed the tracks.
Yesterday we followed the tracks and found it.
Yesterday we followed the tracks and found it, but then a signal booms. Run!
We looked. Found it!
Yesterday we asked for help honestly, and we found it!
Yesterday we asked for help honestly, and we found it. But a signal booms. Run!

x: Ready, steady, go!
Go! {crowd} clap, and everyone rushes ahead!
Go! {crowd} clap so loudly that everything shakes, and the teams rush to the finish!
Oh, help!
Oh! I am all tangled up! Help!
Oh dear! I am so tangled up that I cannot move at all!
Hold on! I will help!
Hold on, {rival}! I will help, and then we run on!
Hold on, {rival}! Fair play means helping, even when we are racing.
A knot! We need words!
All in knots! We need magic words!
Everything is tangled into one huge knot. We need magic words!
How shall we celebrate?
Everyone reached the finish together! How shall we celebrate?
Everyone reached the finish together: a draw! How shall we celebrate, {name}?
Hooray! A party!
Hooray! A party for everyone, and the cake is for everyone too!
Hooray! A party for everyone! We share the cake, and I get a bigger bit. Joking, equal slices!
The prize is for all!
Let's share the prize with everyone! It is more fun.
Let's share the prize with everyone! One is fun, but together is a hundred times more fun.

end: A draw! Friends!
Everyone finishes together: a draw, and now we are friends!
Everyone reaches the finish at once: a draw! And {rival} is now our best friend and teammate.

x: {crowd} are waiting.
{event} is soon, and {crowd} are very excited.
{event} is soon, and {crowd} are excited: everything must be ready. Let's build a helper machine, {fr}!
A machine? Hooray!
Let's build a machine! I will press the buttons!
Let's build a machine! I am in charge of the most important button, the red shiny one.
Here is the plan.
Here is the plan! I am {npc}, and I will help!
Here is the plan! I am {npc}, and I will help you build the machine. Just do not press the red button!
The machine is silent!
The machine is silent and will not start. We need magic words!
The machine stands still as a stone and will not start. We need magic words!

q: What does the helper warn about?
Do not press the red button

x: What is the machine's job?
What will the machine's job be? You choose!
What will the machine's job be? You choose, {name}, and I will screw on the right parts!
It carries everything!
The machine carries any weight! What strength!
The machine carries any weight! Right now it is carrying me too.
Everything sparkles!
The machine decorates everything and sweeps up the mess.
The machine decorates everything and sweeps up after itself. What a clever one!

end: Bang! The red button!
{fr} presses the red button, and the machine hums!
{fr} presses the red button by accident, and the machine starts to hum, shake and grow!

rec: It carries everything!
The carrying machine hums and carries everything in sight!
Yesterday we built a carrying machine, and now it hums and carries everything in sight!
It paints everything!
The tidy machine hums and decorates everything in sight!
Yesterday we built a tidy machine, and now it hums and decorates everything in sight!

x: Oh! It is growing!
It does its job faster and faster!
It does its job faster and faster, and I cannot laugh fast enough!
Find the screw!
Only the little main screw can stop it!
Only the little main screw can stop it. It rolled away somewhere under the stairs!
I have an idea!
I have a trick: let's run it round in circles!
I have an idea: let's run the machine round in circles until it tires, and we quietly fetch the screw!
It will not listen!
The machine will not listen. We need magic words!
The machine hums and will not listen to anyone. We need magic words!
What shall we do first?
What shall we do first? You choose!
What shall we do first, {name}? There is little time, and the machine is quick!
Round and round!
The machine runs in circles, and the screw is already in sight!
The machine runs in circles, slower and slower, and a little screw shines under it!
{crowd}, come here!
{crowd} come running and count together: "One, two, three!"
{crowd} come running to help and count together: one, two, three, and pull the machine by a rope!

end: Stop! Where is it going?
Suddenly the machine breaks loose and rushes away!
Suddenly the machine breaks loose and rushes straight {place_to}, where {crowd} are waiting!

rec: It rushes away!
Yesterday the machine ran in circles, now it rushes {place_to}!
Yesterday the machine ran in circles, and now it rushes {place_to}, and we rush after it!
A crowd runs after it!
We called everyone to help, and a crowd runs after the machine!
Yesterday we called everyone to help, and now a whole crowd of kind helpers runs after the machine!

x: Stop, machine!
Stop, machine! {crowd} are here!
Stop, machine! {crowd} are here, and {event} is soon too! Brakes, where are the brakes?
It wants to help!
It is not mean! It really wants to help, it just tries too hard.
It is not mean, it just really wants to help! We must give it the right job.
Give it a job!
Give it one small kind job, and it will calm down!
Give it one small kind job, getting everything ready for the party, and it will calm down!
It cannot hear!
The machine rushes on and cannot hear. We need magic words!
The machine rushes like the wind and hears nobody. We need magic words!

q: What is the machine really like?
What must we give the machine?

x: What about the machine?
The party is saved! What do we do with the machine?
The party is saved! What do we do with our machine, {name}?
It is our friend!
The machine stays with us and does not grow any more.
The machine stays with us, helps everyone and never grows again. Even when I ask.
Let it help!
The machine stays here and helps everyone every day!
The machine stays {place_in} and helps everyone every day, humming politely.

end: Hooray! All are happy!
{event} begins, and all is ready. Hooray for the inventors!
{event} begins, and all is ready in time. What real inventors!

x: Look, a map!
Look, {name}: we found an old map {place_in}!
Look, {name}: we found an old map {place_in}, all dusty and full of riddles!
We will find {thing_acc}!
It is a treasure map! We will find {thing_acc}!
It is a treasure map! We follow the clues and find {thing_acc}, right, {fr}?
Steps: 2 and 2.
Riddle: take as many steps as a cat has legs.
The map has a riddle: "Take as many steps as a cat has paws, and one more." How many?
The hiding place is shut!
We found a hiding place, but it is shut. We need magic words!
We took the right steps, and a hiding place showed in the wall! It is shut. We need magic words!

q: How many steps must we take?

x: Which way first?
The path splits in two. Which way first?
The path splits in two. Which way first, {name}?
Left! Let's go!
Left it is! Let's go before the path changes its mind!
Left it is! Let's go quickly, before the path changes its mind and turns.
Right! Let's go!
Right it is! I think the map is upside down.
Right it is! Though I think we are holding the map upside down.

end: Who is rustling?
Something rustles behind us. Who is following us?
Suddenly something rustles behind us. Someone is following our tracks, and it seems they have a map too!

rec: We went left.
Yesterday we went left, and something rustles behind us.
Yesterday we went left, and something rustled behind us. We turn round!
We went right.
Yesterday we went right, and something rustles behind us.
Yesterday we went right, and something rustled behind us. We turn round!

x: It is my map too!
I have a piece of this map too! Here!
Ha! I have a piece of this map too. You will not get far without it!
Let's go together!
Let's search together! Two halves are better than one.
Let's search together! Two halves of a map make a whole map, and a whole map is nearly a treasure.
Three doors. Not 1, not 2.
Doors: red, blue, green. We need not red and not blue.
The second half says: "Three doors: red, blue, green. We need not red and not blue." Which one?
The door is locked!
The green door is locked. We need magic words!
The green door is tall and has a secret lock. We need magic words!

q: Behind which door is the clue?

x: What about the pieces?
We have both halves. What shall we do with them?
We have both halves, and we are tired. What shall we do, {name}?
The halves fit!
The halves fit together, and a new path appears on the map!
The halves fit with a soft click, and a new shiny path lights up on the map!
A rest! Hooray!
A rest with sandwiches! The map can wait, and I cannot.
A rest with sandwiches! The map can wait, but the sandwiches cannot, they are begging to be eaten.

end: The door opens!
The door creaks slowly. Behind it is a dark tunnel and an echo!
The door opens slowly. Behind it is a dark tunnel, and an echo calls merrily: "Come here!"

rec: The map is whole!
Yesterday we put two halves of the map together, and the door opened.
Yesterday we put two halves of the map together, and the door opened. Now into the dark tunnel!
After the rest, onward!
Yesterday we had a rest, and then the door opened.
Yesterday we had a rest, and then the door opened. Now into the dark tunnel!

x: A chest! Hooray!
A chest! It shines so bright it dazzles our eyes!
Here is the chest! It shines so bright it dazzles our eyes, and my tummy rumbles with joy.
Code: 1, 2, ? Total 6.
Code: 1, 2 and one more number. Six in all.
On the lock: "The code has three numbers: 1, 2 and one more. Together they make six."
Three! It is three!
1 and 2 make three. Three more to reach six!
1 and 2 make three. Three more to reach six. So the code is one, two, three!
The lid holds!
The code is right, but the lid will not lift. We need magic words!
The code is right, but the lid is heavy as a mountain and will not lift. We need magic words!
What about the treasure?
The chest is open! What shall we do with the find?
The chest is open! What shall we do with the find, {name}? We found it as three friends!
Equal for all!
Equal for all! Now everyone has a piece of the wonder.
Equal for all! Everyone now has a piece of the wonder, and I have friends too.
Hooray! A party!
A party! And a pie with the map on top, so we remember the way.
A party with the map on a pie! So nobody forgets the way, and so we can eat it later.

end: A shared treasure! Hooray!
{thing} is in the chest! What a find for everyone!
{thing} is in the chest! We searched together, so the joy is for everyone, and it is big.
